column1: 自动判定成功 / 失败

column2: On: uses the built-in word list to decide whether a reply means success or failure.\nOff: replies are only logged, never judged — you confirm targets yourself.

column1: 开：点什么学什么（不再按关键词过滤）；判定时**只要机器人有回复就算成功**，\n但命中明确失败词（活动已结束 / 请先关注 / 未绑定 等）仍判失败。\n适合判定词千奇百怪的机器人。关：完全按下面的规则判定。
column2: On: learn whatever you tap (no keyword filter), and **treat any reply as success** when judging — except replies that clearly mean failure (event ended / follow first / not linked, etc.), which still fail.\nFor bots with unpredictable wording. Off: judge purely by the rules below.
